_comment_heartbeat: A node is marked OFFLINE if no heartbeat arrives within this many seconds. Nodes beat every 2s, so 6s = 3 missed beats.
_comment_nodes: One entry per ESP32. 'order' defines ball progression START -> FINISH. 'gap_mm' is the distance between IR beam A and beam B on that station, and is the number velocity depends on - measure it, do not assume it.
